The gating itself is the framework R19 [F] result, not asserted from this measurement.

LCT_promoter_accessibility.claim: LCT promoter overlaps ENCODE DNase clusters (open chromatin) -> accessible, as E1 requires

MCM6_enhancer.claim: MCM6 -13910 region is an ENCODE-annotated DISTAL ENHANCER -> E2 premise externally confirmed

age_dynamics.claim: LCT promoter methylation INCREASES with age in lactase-non-persistent (-13910 CC) individuals; the -13910*T allele prevents age-dependent methylation, maintaining lactase
age_dynamics.specific_CpG: cg20242066 (LCT promoter; methylation tracks -13910 genotype, persistence phenotype, and lactase enzymatic activity)
refs: Labrie et al. 2016 Nat Struct Mol Biol 23:566 (DNA-variation-dependent epigenetic aging)
Leseva/Oh et al. 2018 Sci Rep 8:5649 (HM450 differentially methylated position in LCT promoter)

physical_loop.claim: the MCM6 intron-13 (-13910) enhancer physically contacts the LCT promoter via CHROMATIN LOOPING; in persistence, TFs (Oct-1, GATA-6, HNF-3A) bound at the enhancer recruit TET demethylases to the LCT promoter, keeping it demethylated
physical_loop.significance: closes E2's physical-loop [O]: the -13910<->LCT loop is established, and it is the mechanism COUPLING E2 (looping) -> M (promoter methylation) exactly as the three-layer model posits
refs: Misceo et al. 2024 (review: LCT-MCM6 methylation-altering TFs via chromatin looping)
